update.title: The Ultimate Simulator Station Update
features: Ultimate Weather Engine: Take absolute command of the skies. Inject live real-world METAR data, build custom conditions, or trigger intense scenarios like severe windshear.
Complete Ground Handling & GSX: Turnarounds are now incredibly immersive. Seamlessly manage pushback, boarding, and all ground vehicles with full GSX integration.
Advanced Failure Management: Test your airmanship with over 130 meticulously simulated system failures, now officially supported for MSFS 2020/2024.
Interactive TCAS & Traffic Injection: Inject custom AI traffic, configure precise crossing scenarios, practice wake turbulence, and handle surprise runway incursions.
Advanced Flight Analysis: Perfect your landings with deep performance grading. Review beautiful interactive telemetry profiles and comprehensive touchdown evaluations.
Instant World Tour Mode: Skip the setup time. Instantly teleport your aircraft to over 30 breathtaking global landmarks with a single tap for immediate sightseeing.

announcement.title: Massive Leap Forward!
announcement.body:
Welcome to the biggest, most feature-packed update in our history! We have completely leveled up your flight simulation experience across MSFS (2020/2024) and X-Plane. Enjoy absolute command over the skies with our Ultimate Weather Engine, seamless GSX ground handling, deep flight analysis, and interactive TCAS traffic injection.

ATTENTION EXISTING USERS: The connection architecture has been completely overhauled for maximum performance. MSFS users now require the new upgraded Bridge (delivering massive FPS improvements), and X-Plane users now utilize a brand-new connection method. You MUST review the updated Documentation for your specific simulator to connect successfully.

promo_banner.title: Ground Handling Perfected
promo_banner.body: Turnarounds just got incredibly immersive! Manage your entire ground crew, request boarding bridges, and call in all vehicles directly from your device.
